mapper.update: ALTER TABLE job_seeker_profile ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS name VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE job_seeker_profile ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS birth_date DATE DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE job_seeker_profile ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gender VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL
ALTER TABLE job_seeker_profile ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_seeker_profile ( member_id, name, birth_date, gender, email, phone, profile_image_url, residence_region, desired_job, desired_region, employment_type, career_type, career_years, min_salary, remote_preferred, flexible_preferred, hybrid_preferred, onsite_preferred, contact_time_start, contact_time_end, contact_method, introduction, profile_public ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{residenceRegion}, #{desiredJob}, #{desiredRegion}, #{employmentType}, #{careerType}, #{careerYears}, #{minSalary}, #{remotePreferred}, #{flexiblePreferred}, #{hybridPreferred}, #{onsitePreferred}, #{contactTimeStart}, #{contactTimeEnd}, #{contactMethod}, #{introduction}, #{profilePublic} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS memberId, COALESCE(p.name, m.name) AS name, COALESCE(p.birth_date, m.birth_date) AS birthDate, COALESCE(p.gender, m.gender) AS gender, COALESCE(p.email, m.email) AS email, COALESCE(p.phone, m.phone) AS phone, p.id AS profileId, p.profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, p.residence_region AS residenceRegion, p.desired_job AS desiredJob, p.desired_region AS desiredRegion, p.employment_type AS employmentType, p.career_type AS careerType, p.career_years AS careerYears, p.min_salary AS minSalary, p.remote_preferred AS remotePreferred, p.flexible_preferred AS flexiblePreferred, p.hybrid_preferred AS hybridPreferred, p.onsite_preferred AS onsitePreferred, p.contact_time_start AS contactTimeStart, p.contact_time_end AS contactTimeEnd, p.contact_method AS contactMethod, p.introduction AS introduction, p.profile_public AS profilePublic, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM member m LEFT JOIN job_seeker_profile p ON m.id = p.member_id WHERE m.id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_seeker_profile SET name = #{name}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, residence_region = #{residenceRegion}, desired_job = #{desiredJob}, desired_region = #{desiredRegion}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, career_type = #{careerType}, career_years = #{careerYears}, min_salary = #{minSalary}, remote_preferred = #{remotePreferred}, flexible_preferred = #{flexiblePreferred}, hybrid_preferred = #{hybridPreferred}, onsite_preferred = #{onsitePreferred}, contact_time_start = #{contactTimeStart}, contact_time_end = #{contactTimeEnd}, contact_method = #{contactMethod}, introduction = #{introduction}, profile_public = #{profilePublic} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
